historical_significance: 孟德尔（1822-1884），奥地利奥古斯廷会修士，遗传学之父，通过豆类实验发现遗传定律，被现代 biology 称为孟德尔定律的发现者，其工作在1900年被三位科学家独立 rediscovered，开启了现代 genetics 时代。
historical_significance_en: Mendel (1822-1884), Austrian Augustinian monk, father of genetics, discovered laws of inheritance through pea plant experiments, his work rediscovered independently in 1900 by three scientists, launching the modern genetics era.
